title: Aroyl-S,N-ketene acetal-triarylamine bichromophores – intramolecular energy transfer and dual emission upon induced aggregation and encapsulation
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,10255-10260
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09361A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Abdelouahad El Abbassi, Julius Krenzer, Eugene P. Petrov, Lukas Biesen, Vera Vasylyeva, Sarah Merzenich, Ute Resch-Genger, Thomas J. J. Müller
Aroyl-S,N-ketene acetal bichromophores show enhanced emission upon aggregation and encapsulation. Partial energy transfer is controlled by substitution pattern and leads to aggregation induced dual emission (AIDE).
